title: Ge Hong and the Making of an Emergency Medicine Formulary
version: Textual history and discussion of the Daoist Canon
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.locator: Textual history and discussion of the Daoist Canon
passages.note: The dissertation discusses Ge Hong’s fourth-century medical text, later revision and its preservation in the 1445 Daoist Canon. The surviving witness cannot be assumed to reproduce fourth-century wording without change; the cited chapter includes a reference to Qinghao.
